svg.title: Operate Four Core Seats; Add Two Only in the Scaled Model
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-core-six-scaled-publishing-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Operate Four Core Seats; Add Two Only in the Scaled Model; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled: 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Six entries depict four core seats and two Scaled-only expansion seats. A numeric value of 1 marks a person included in the core pod; 0 marks an expansion seat excluded from core headcount, not an unstaffed role once scaled. The core is 1 FT + 3 C (4 people); adding 1 FT + 1 C produces 2 FT + 4 C (6 people). Contractor seats are fractional service relationships, not full-time equivalents. External vendor/trade sub-crews are direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not internal pod seats. FYMC 2.0 score: 89/100; rank #07 of 29; tier: Elite Small-Team Cash Machine.; caption: The four-person core supports the canonical $80,000 Conservative and $490,000 Base scenarios; the six-person configuration belongs to the $900,000 Scaled scenario. Add the full-time partnerships lead and contracted production specialist only when funded workload justifies expansion. Resize paid capacity for Conservative revenue; scenario revenue alone does not establish workload capacity.; stages: label: Portfolio operator; value: Core seat 1: full-time portfolio and commercial ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own topic allocation, site-level profit reporting, partner concentration, and capital deployment. Reconcile advertising, payable affiliate commissions, and delivered sponsorships. Maintain the rights register and transaction-ready records; retain commercial responsibility until the expansion lead joins.; label: Managing editor; value: Core seat 2: contracted editorial ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own evidence standards, contributor briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh priorities within contracted capacity. Review commercial claims, contributor rights, and disclosure placement; prevent duplicative programmatic page expansion.; label: Technical SEO engineer; value: Core seat 3: contracted technical delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain crawl monitoring, template tests, structured data, analytics connectors, and deployment checks. Route indexing regressions to a tracked repair queue instead of mass resubmission; support the operator's revenue reporting.; label: Subject and production specialist; value: Core seat 4: contracted research, writing, and CMS production; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Produce original explanations, testing records, and attributable expert contributions. Supply source packets and documented media rights, format accessible pages, and verify internal links. Scope combined research and production work to purchased capacity rather than assuming multiple full-time roles.; label: Growth partnerships lead; value: Scaled-only seat 5: additional full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add one FT seat in the Scaled configuration to diversify sponsorships and manage partner renewals. Protect editorial independence and document placement obligations before recognizing sponsor revenue; this seat is outside the core pod.; label: Production specialist; value: Scaled-only seat 6: additional contracted production capacity; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add one C seat in the Scaled configuration for licensed visuals, accessible CMS formatting, and publication checks. Relieve the core subject specialist's production workload only after measuring editorial review capacity and the refresh backlog; this seat is outside the core pod.
